model_selection_rule: Fit on source training only. Select the highest question-equal source-development macro-F1; ties (12 decimal places) use lower question-equal multiclass log loss, then the fixed candidate order. No target labels are used for model selection.
threshold_objective: Source-development HELP minus HURT; tie by fewer actual recheck tokens; strict score > threshold
heldout_rule: no final evaluation until all planned held-out and adaptation pairs are collected
